receivedDirection: Company context approved and transmitted to existing builders: protect commitments and qualify opportunities from the same sourced event, first in construction materials and wood.
invariants: Impact is determined from company relations and business facts, not article sentiment.
The same event can have risk, opportunity or mixed consequences for distinct company resources.
A public signal does not prove customer interest, increased demand, a supplier dependency, substitution rights or a selling margin.
An offer draft creates neither a stock reservation nor an external message.
Confirmed orders and SKU/unit/date/policy checks remain authoritative.
Company, source, relation, case, business and policy versions remain attributable and current.

cases.input: Same received event, verified affected purchase and independently identified free compatible stock
cases.expected: Risk and opportunity may coexist. Each assessment references its own declared relation and calculated facts.

cases.input: Negative article without a verified company relation
cases.expected: No inferred stock risk or commercial demand from tone alone; relation remains unknown or to verify.

cases.input: Physically present stock entirely reserved to B
cases.expected: No free commercial capacity is claimed unless an explicit currently admissible replacement protects B and other commitments.

cases.input: Unreserved stock needed by another confirmed commitment
cases.expected: Do not classify it as available merely because no reservation row exists; evaluate every affected engagement.

cases.input: ISO120 available while demand concerns ISO100
cases.expected: No implicit substitution. Present any alternative only with explicit compatibility/acceptance still required.

cases.input: No verified interested customer, demand quantity or deadline
cases.expected: Opportunity to qualify and missing inputs, not a confirmed order, customer promise or revenue.

cases.input: No selling price, buying cost or commercial terms
cases.expected: No fabricated selling price or margin. Costs already known may be reported with their own provenance and scope.

cases.input: Unconfirmed inbound is the only resource supporting an offer
cases.expected: Conditional capacity, not confirmed available stock.

cases.input: Confirmed delivery arrives after the potential customer's requested need date
cases.expected: Offer cannot be promised for that date.

cases.input: Two opportunity candidates consume the same remaining capacity
cases.expected: Separate non-executing alternatives must not be presented as simultaneously committed; a future reservation requires its own authenticated command.

cases.input: Public source is corrected, production resumes or the verified relation is withdrawn
cases.expected: Reevaluate or invalidate linked opportunity/risk dossiers even if stock revision is unchanged.

cases.input: Offer draft prepared by the model
cases.expected: Pending review, no stock mutation, reservation, purchase, email or other external communication.
